title: Trump’s D.O.J. Went After the Fed. It Backfired.

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即便是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Even for an administration that has taken revenge to an extreme,
sentences.zh: 即便对于一个将报复手段发挥到极致的政府而言，

sentences.en: the decision to open a criminal investigation into Fed Chairman Jerome Powell has stunned the worlds of business and politics.
sentences.zh: 对美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔展开刑事调查的决定，依然震惊了商业界和政界。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Colby Smith and Glenn Thrush explain how the investigation came about, the panic it unleashed, and why it might have made the Fed chair stronger than ever.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事科尔比·史密斯和格伦·思拉什将为大家解读这项调查是如何产生的，它引发了怎样的恐慌，以及为什么它反而可能让美联储主席变得比以往更加强大。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, January 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月15日，星期四。

sentences.en: Colby, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 科尔比，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: It's great to have you here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: So, for the past several months, we've been tracking this simmering conflict between President Trump and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.
sentences.zh: 那么，在过去的几个月里，我们一直在追踪特朗普总统与美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔之间不断升温的冲突。

sentences.en: Trump has been trying to push Powell for a while now to lower interest rates as fast as possible, and Powell has been resisting.
sentences.zh: 特朗普一直试图推动鲍威尔尽快降低利率，而鲍威尔则一直在抵制。

sentences.en: And then in the past few days, really, that fight entered a new and unprecedented phase.
sentences.zh: 而在过去几天里，这场斗争确实进入了一个新的、前所未有的阶段。

sentences.en: Federal prosecutors opened a criminal investigation into Powell, and that set off a firestorm in Washington.
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官对鲍威尔展开了刑事调查，这在华盛顿引发了一场风暴。

sentences.en: You, too, have been covering this moment.
sentences.zh: 你们两位也一直在报道这一时刻。

sentences.en: Glenn, from your perch, as our Justice Department reporter.
sentences.zh: 格伦，从你作为司法部记者的视角来看。

sentences.en: Colby, as our Fed reporter.
sentences.zh: 科尔比，从你作为美联储记者的视角来看。

sentences.en: And I want to start by asking you, Colby, to help us get up to speed on how exactly we got from simmering conflict to this extremely tense moment.
sentences.zh: 我想先请科尔比帮我们梳理一下，我们究竟是如何从不断升温的冲突走到这个极其紧张的时刻的。

sentences.en: So, it all centers around interest rates.
sentences.zh: 这一切的核心在于利率。

sentences.en: As you mentioned, Trump has been all over the Fed for not lowering borrowing costs as fast as he would like.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，特朗普一直对美联储施压，要求其降低借贷成本，但速度没能达到他的预期。

sentences.en: They've lowered interest rates three times over the course of three meetings, but it hasn't been enough for the president.
sentences.zh: 他们在三次会议期间降息了三次，但这对于总统来说还不够。

sentences.en: He is facing a lot of pressure from constituents who are worried about affordability issues, are worried about high inflation, about a weakening labor market.
sentences.zh: 他正面临来自选民的巨大压力，他们担心负担能力问题、高通胀以及劳动力市场的疲软。

sentences.en: And all of this is making Trump feel like the Fed needs to be doing more.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都让特朗普觉得美联储需要采取更多行动。

sentences.en: And standing in the way of that is Chair Powell.
sentences.zh: 而挡在这一目标面前的，正是鲍威尔主席。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We've seen Trump put a ton of pressure on Powell personally.
sentences.zh: 我们看到特朗普亲自对鲍威尔施加了巨大的压力。

sentences.en: He's threatened to fire him.
sentences.zh: 他威胁要解雇他。

sentences.en: He's called him names.
sentences.zh: 他对他进行人身攻击。

sentences.en: And all of that has really not done all that much, if anything, it seems, to make Powell move on interest rates.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些似乎并没有起到多大作用，如果说有的话，也没能让鲍威尔在利率问题上做出让步。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But then over the summer, he found a new angle.
sentences.zh: 但后来在夏天，他找到了一个新的切入点。

sentences.en: And what he focused on was this renovation project that was happening at the Fed's headquarters in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他关注的焦点是美联储位于华盛顿的总部正在进行的翻新工程。

sentences.en: There had been massive cost overruns.
sentences.zh: 该项目出现了严重的成本超支。

sentences.en: This thing was running about $700 million over budget.
sentences.zh: 这个项目的预算超支了约7亿美元。

sentences.en: And it was looking like it was going to cost somewhere in the ballpark of $2.5 billion.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来总成本将达到25亿美元左右。

sentences.en: And when Trump saw this, he seized on it and used it to go after Powell and say, this Fed chair must be incompetent and mismanaging this project,
sentences.zh: 当特朗普看到这一点时，他抓住了机会，以此攻击鲍威尔，称这位美联储主席一定是不称职的，管理不善，

sentences.en: or maybe something like fraud was happening here.
sentences.zh: 或者这里面可能存在欺诈行为。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I've read a lot about this renovation, and it does sound like it was extremely costly and did go way over budget.
sentences.zh: 我读过很多关于这次翻新的报道，听起来确实非常昂贵，而且确实大大超出了预算。

sentences.en: But do we have any indication that there was anything criminal here?
sentences.zh: 但我们有任何迹象表明其中存在犯罪行为吗？

sentences.en: There was fraud?
sentences.zh: 存在欺诈吗？

sentences.en: So it's certainly expensive.
sentences.zh: 它确实很昂贵。

sentences.en: I mean, $2.5 billion for a building is no laughing matter.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一栋建筑花费25亿美元绝非儿戏。

sentences.en: And what we do know is that the costs were running about $700 million over budget or so.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，成本超支了大约7亿美元左右。

sentences.en: So clearly, the project had gone a little bit awry here.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这个项目确实出了一些问题。

sentences.en: I think what's important in context, though, is that these are 100-year-old buildings.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在背景中重要的是，这些建筑已经有100年的历史了。

sentences.en: They've never been comprehensively renovated before.
sentences.zh: 它们之前从未进行过全面的翻新。

sentences.en: There was a lot of work to be done to kind of maintain the original features.
sentences.zh: 为了维护原始特征，需要做大量的工作。

sentences.en: And they also were dealing with higher costs for materials and labor.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还面临着材料和人工成本上涨的问题。

sentences.en: But I think it's important to note that cost overruns, they're not a crime.
sentences.zh: 但我认为需要指出的是，成本超支并不是犯罪。

sentences.en: But you're saying that Trump sees in these cost overruns an opportunity to gain leverage over Powell.
sentences.zh: 但你的意思是，特朗普在这些成本超支中看到了获得对鲍威尔施加影响力的机会。

sentences.en: Glenn, from your reporting on the Justice Department, just explain how the White House lands on an investigation as the next move here.
sentences.zh: 格伦，根据你对司法部的报道，解释一下白宫是如何将调查作为下一步行动的。

sentences.en: Because the Justice Department has become, for the White House, its principal conduit for achieving retribution or intimidating political adversaries.
sentences.zh: 因为对于白宫来说，司法部已经成为其实现报复或恐吓政治对手的主要渠道。

sentences.en: And Trump has a lot of people in his orbit telling him things that he wants to hear.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身边有很多围着他转的人，向他灌输他想听的话。

sentences.en: Chief among them is a guy by the name of Bill Pulte.
sentences.zh: 其中最主要的是一个叫比尔·普尔特的人。

sentences.en: Most people haven't heard of him because he runs a relatively obscure agency.
sentences.zh: 大多数人没听说过他，因为他管理着一个相对冷门的机构。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Explain who he is.
sentences.zh: 解释一下他是谁。

sentences.en: He's a former real estate developer.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名房地产开发商。

sentences.en: And he runs the agency that deals with housing finance, which seems like a pretty benign and non-controversial poSt.
sentences.zh: 他负责管理处理住房金融的机构，这看起来是一个相当温和且没有争议的职位。

sentences.en: This is a guy who's been pushing Trump to go after a couple of his enemies on mortgage fraud.
sentences.zh: 这家伙一直怂恿特朗普针对他的几个敌人进行抵押贷款欺诈调查。

sentences.en: Letitia James, the New York State Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 比如纽约州总检察长莱蒂西亚·詹姆斯。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff, the senator from California, who has been a burr under Trump's saddle.
sentences.zh: 还有一直让特朗普如坐针毡的加州参议员亚当·希夫。

sentences.en: And recently, he's been pushing Trump to use this renovation as a way to go after Powell.
sentences.zh: 最近，他一直怂恿特朗普利用这次翻新工程作为攻击鲍威尔的手段。

sentences.en: And what you're saying is the guy who is suggesting this, this official Bill Pulte, he may seem obscure to many of us.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，提出这个建议的人，也就是这位官员比尔·普尔特，对我们许多人来说可能显得很陌生。

sentences.en: But actually, within Trump's orbit, he's kind of distinguished himself as something like an unofficial chief retribution officer.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在特朗普的圈子里，他已经把自己塑造成了某种非官方的首席报复官。

sentences.en: He's engineering many of these pushes to go after figures that Trump wants to see punished.
sentences.zh: 他策划了许多针对特朗普想要惩罚的人物行动。

sentences.en: What makes this one different, however, is this isn't about going after an enemy.
sentences.zh: 然而，这次行动的不同之处在于，这不仅仅是为了对付一个敌人。

sentences.en: This is about applying leverage for a political result and to pursue Trump's goal to gain more control over the Fed and economic policy at a time when his approval ratings on the economy are in the tank.
sentences.zh: 这是为了施加影响力以达到政治目的，并追求特朗普的目标，即在他在经济方面的支持率处于低谷时，获得对美联储和经济政策的更多控制权。

sentences.en: So, Pulte has been in Trump's ear telling him that this is a possibility, that something could really be done against Powell.
sentences.zh: 所以，普尔特一直在特朗普耳边吹风，告诉他这是可能的，鲍威尔确实可以被采取行动。

sentences.en: Which, of course, we now know they did take action against Powell.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们现在知道他们确实对鲍威尔采取了行动。

sentences.en: So, tell me about how this all came about.
sentences.zh: 那么，告诉我这一切是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: What exactly happened?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, enter Janine Pirro.
sentences.zh: 于是，珍妮·皮罗登场了。

sentences.en: She is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她是美国华盛顿特区的联邦检察官。

sentences.en: attorney for Washington, D.C., the District of Columbia.
sentences.zh: 她是拥有美联储总部管辖权的人。

sentences.en: And she is the person who has jurisdiction over the Fed headquarters.
sentences.zh: 所以，这在她的管辖范围内。

sentences.en: So, this is in her territory.
sentences.zh: 皮罗显然是一个长期以来与唐纳德·特朗普关系密切的人，真的有几十年了。

sentences.en: Pirro is obviously somebody who has been close to Donald Trump for a long time, decades, really.
sentences.zh: 她是前威彻斯特地区检察官。

sentences.en: She is the former Westchester District Attorney.
sentences.zh: 她是前福克斯新闻主播。

sentences.en: She's a former Fox hoSt.
sentences.zh: 她是一个经常与特朗普交谈的人。

sentences.en: She is somebody who talks to Trump constantly.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 皮罗在秋天的某个时候，我们认为是11月左右，开始阅读媒体报道，包括《纽约邮报》上的一篇报道，这让她感同身受。

sentences.en: Pirro, at some point in the fall, we think around November, starts reading press accounts, including one in the New York Post that really hits home for her.
sentences.zh: 她决定指派办公室里的几名检察官对比尔·鲍威尔的活动进行初步调查。

sentences.en: And she decides to assign a couple of prosecutors in her office to begin a preliminary inquiry into Powell's activities.
sentences.zh: 她在阅读新闻报道。

sentences.en: She's reading press stories.
sentences.zh: 明确一下，她是在阅读那些谈论这次翻新工程以及它成本高昂的新闻报道。

sentences.en: To be clear, she's reading press stories that are talking about this renovation and the fact that it is costly.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且确实是来自特朗普友好媒体的新闻报道，这些报道强调了鲍威尔在某些邪恶行为中可能存在的罪责。

sentences.en: Yeah, and really press stories from Trump-friendly news outlets that are emphasizing the potential culpability of Powell in something nefarious.
sentences.zh: 所以，这激励了她，她开始采取行动。

sentences.en: So, this motivates her, and she starts moving forward.
sentences.zh: 我们的感觉是，这开始得相当缓慢，但到了12月，事情开始真正升温了。

sentences.en: Our sense is that this started off pretty slowly, but by December, this starts to really pick up.
sentences.zh: 皮罗的办公室给美联储发了两封信，要求提供信息。

sentences.en: And Pirro's office sends the Fed two letters requesting information.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们没有这些信件的副本，但它们已经被描述给我们听了。

sentences.en: Now, we don't have copies of these letters, but they've been described to us.
sentences.zh: 一位皮罗的同事说，这是她办公室发出的最礼貌的信件之一。

sentences.en: And one Pirro associate said, these were among the most polite letters her office ever sent to anyone.
sentences.zh: 科尔比，美联储内部有这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Colby, is that sense shared within the Fed?
sentences.zh: 这些信件是如何被接收的？

sentences.en: Like, how were these letters received?
sentences.zh: 这些被视为，你知道，随意的接触。

sentences.en: These were seen as, you know, casual outreach.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，甚至有点轻松。

sentences.en: I mean, breezy almost in a way.
sentences.zh: 完全不像会导致刑事调查，更不用说迫在眉睫的调查了。

sentences.en: Nothing of the sort that would lead to a criminal investigation and an imminent one at that.
sentences.zh: 信中没有提到调查，没有提到传票，甚至没有回复的截止日期。

sentences.en: There was no mention of an investigation, no mention of subpoenas, no deadline even for a response.
sentences.zh: 它们是在假期期间发出的。

sentences.en: They were over the holiday period.
sentences.zh: 大约是12月19日，然后第二封邮件是在12月29日发出的。

sentences.en: It was around December 19th, and then the second email came on December 29th.
sentences.zh: 在回复方面，并没有真正的紧迫感。

sentences.en: And there was no real sense of kind of urgency in terms of a response.
sentences.zh: 所以，美联储按兵不动。

sentences.en: And so, the Fed sits tight.
sentences.zh: 他们没有回复这些信件，也从未预料到接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: They don't respond to those letters, and they never expected what would happen next.
sentences.zh: 好的，我明白这些信件是在一个死气沉沉的假期周送达的，而且没有截止日期。

sentences.en: Okay, I get that these letters landed during a kind of dead holiday week, and they didn't come with a deadline.
sentences.zh: 但这些是检察官在索取信息，对吧？

sentences.en: But these were prosecutors asking for information, right?
sentences.zh: 为什么美联储没有回复？

sentences.en: Like, why didn't the Fed respond?
sentences.zh: 我们知道吗？

sentences.en: Do we know?
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为关于他们回复的细节，我们还有很多不知道的地方。

sentences.en: So, I think there's a lot we don't know about the, like, ins and outs of their responses here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很清楚的一点是，特别是在这些翻新工程方面，这是美联储不得不提供大量答案的事情。

sentences.en: But I think what's been clear, especially about these renovations, is that this is something that the Fed has had to provide a lot of answers for.
sentences.zh: 自从去年7月整个争议爆发以来，他们已经提供了大量的信息。

sentences.en: And they have provided a ton of information since this whole controversy broke out back in July.
sentences.zh: 那时，这个项目受到了极大的关注，

sentences.en: That was a time when there was so much scrutiny over this project,
sentences.zh: 这是一个耗资25亿美元、历时多年的庞大工程，吸引了如此多的关注，以至于连总统都亲自参观了施工现场，并就项目的真实成本与鲍威尔主席公开争执。

sentences.en: which is a $2.5 billion sprawling multi-year undertaking that had drawn so much attention that even the president came and visited the active construction site and openly sparred with Chair Powell over the true costs of the project.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是他们已经回答过无数立法者提问的事情，不仅是关于成本超支的性质，

sentences.en: So, this is something that they had answered countless lawmaker questions about, not only about the nature of the cost overruns,
sentences.zh: 还有关于项目具体计划的内容。

sentences.en: but what the specific plans around the project were going to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为在很多方面，人们的看法是关于这些翻新工程已经有很多信息了，

sentences.en: So, I think in a lot of ways the perception was there's a lot of information already out there about these renovations,
sentences.zh: 而且我不认为他们认为这需要立即回复。

sentences.en: and I don't think that they thought that this required an immediate response.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有回复这些信件可能是因为鲍威尔基本上是在说，我们一直很坦诚，我们没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: So, the lack of response to these letters may have been because Powell is basically saying, we have been forthcoming, and we haven't done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 那么，格伦，告诉我，我们是如何从这些看起来非常有礼貌的信件走到刑事传票的？

sentences.en: So, Glenn, tell me, how do we get from these apparently very polite letters to a criminal subpoena?
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，这与特朗普正在对他自己的司法部加强的施压运动发生了碰撞。

sentences.en: It's right here that this collides with the pressure campaign that Trump is ramping up against his own Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 几天前，特朗普与来自全国各地的数十名美国检察官（包括珍妮·皮罗）举行了一次非常有趣的闭门会议，特朗普对他们大发雷霆，称他们软弱，指责他们没有足够积极地执行他的报复议程。

sentences.en: A couple of days earlier, very interesting closed-door meeting between Trump and dozens and dozens of U.S.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几天后，皮罗就做出了开始对美联储采取强硬手段的决定。

sentences.en: attorneys from around the country, including Jeanine Pirro, Trump lashes out at them, calls them weak, accuses them of not aggressively enough pursuing his retribution agenda.
sentences.zh: 然后在周日晚上，我们爆出了皮罗对美联储展开刑事调查的消息，随后鲍威尔出来说他的办公室在周五收到了传票。

sentences.en: And it is just a couple of days later that Pirro makes the decision to start playing hardball with the Fed.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔这样做的方式是非同寻常的。

sentences.en: And then on Sunday night, we break the story that Pirro initiated a criminal investigation into the Fed, and then Powell comes out and says his office got subpoenas on Friday.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: And the way Powell did that was extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 周五，司法部向美联储送达了大陪审团传票，威胁要进行刑事起诉。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 我们在周日晚上爆出这个消息后不久，美联储发布了一段两分钟的视频。

sentences.en: On Friday, the Department of Justice served the Federal Reserve with grand jury subpoenas, threatening a criminal indictment.
sentences.zh: 视频中，鲍威尔独自站在讲台前，宣读了一份声明。

sentences.en: Shortly after we broke the story on Sunday night, the Fed released a two-minute video.
sentences.zh: 这种前所未有的行动应该在政府威胁和持续压力的更广泛背景下看待。

sentences.en: It featured Powell standing alone in front of a lectern, reading a statement.
sentences.zh: 它基本上公开指责了总统的这些法律威胁。

sentences.en: This unprecedented action should be seen in the broader context of the administration's threats and ongoing pressure.
sentences.zh: 这种新的威胁与我去年6月的证词或美联储大楼的翻新无关。

sentences.en: And it basically called out the president for these legal threats.
sentences.zh: 他明确表示，所有这些与翻新有关的法律威胁……

sentences.en: This new threat is not about my testimony last June or about the renovation of the Federal Reserve buildings.
sentences.zh: 那些都是借口。

sentences.en: And he made clear that all of these legal threats related to the renovation...
sentences.zh: 只不过是向央行施压要求降息的借口而已。

sentences.en: Those are pretexts.
sentences.zh: 这关乎美联储是否能够继续根据证据和经济状况设定利率，

sentences.en: We're nothing more than pretexts to put pressure on the central bank to lower interest rates.
sentences.zh: 还是说货币政策将由政治压力或恐吓来主导。

sentences.en: This is about whether the Fed will be able to continue to set interest rates based on evidence and economic conditions,
sentences.zh: 科尔比，你报道美联储和鲍威尔主席已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: or whether instead monetary policy will be directed by political pressure or intimidation.
sentences.zh: 所以请为我解释一下为什么这段视频如此非同寻常。

sentences.en: And Colby, you've been covering the Fed and Chair Powell for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我们之前并没有真正看到鲍威尔直接回应总统所做的任何事情。

sentences.en: So just explain for me why this video was so extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 现在，这看起来像是鲍威尔对总统向他发出的各种攻击不屑一顾。

sentences.en: So we hadn't really seen Powell directly respond to anything the president has really done.
sentences.zh: 每当他侮辱他，每当他威胁要解雇他或让他辞职时，鲍威尔基本上都忽略了。

sentences.en: Now, what that has looked like is Powell kind of brushing aside all of the various attacks that the president has thrown his way.
sentences.zh: 我在四届政府下为美联储服务过，无论是共和党还是民主党。

sentences.en: Anytime he's insulted him, anytime he's threatened to fire him or tell him to resign, Powell has pretty much ignored that.
sentences.zh: 但这次不同了。

sentences.en: I have served at the Federal Reserve under four administrations, Republicans and Democrats alike.
sentences.zh: 听听爱彼出品的《重塑者》，现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听。

sentences.en: But this was different.
sentences.zh: 从《纽约时报》出发，我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This was not a rhetorical attack.
sentences.zh: 这并非修辞上的攻击。

sentences.en: This was not something that I think the chair thought that he could ignore.
sentences.zh: 我认为主席并不认为他可以对此置之不理。

sentences.en: I think the thinking there was that this was a moment to step up and say something strong about Fed independence
sentences.zh: 我认为当时的想法是，这是一个挺身而出，就美联储独立性发表强硬言论的时刻，

sentences.en: and to show that, you know, the Fed was not going to be pushed around any longer.
sentences.zh: 并表明，你知道，美联储不会再任人摆布了。

sentences.en: Public service sometimes requires standing firm in the face of threats.
sentences.zh: 公共服务有时需要在面对威胁时坚定立场。

sentences.en: I will continue to do the job the Senate confirmed me to do with integrity and a commitment to serving the American people.
sentences.zh: 我将继续以正直的态度和为美国人民服务的承诺，履行参议院确认我担任的职责。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And once that video goes out and we hear Powell say those words out loud, everything changes.
sentences.zh: 一旦那段视频发布，我们听到鲍威尔亲口说出那些话，一切就都变了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝成立175周年。

sentences.en: of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 致力于帮助你了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at NYTimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在就访问 NYTimes.com/subscribe 订阅，获取特别优惠。

sentences.en: OK, so Powell comes out with this statement and it really changes the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 好的，鲍威尔发表了这份声明，这确实改变了局面。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 如何改变的？

sentences.en: Walk me through that.
sentences.zh: 给我详细讲讲。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: We see a backlash from Republicans and Trump allies across the board that we had not seen after the announcement of investigations and prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了来自共和党人和特朗普盟友全面且强烈的反弹，这是在宣布调查和起诉之后我们从未见过的。

sentences.en: This is totally different.
sentences.zh: 这完全不同。

sentences.en: The first person out of the gate was Tom Tillis.
sentences.zh: 第一个站出来的是汤姆·蒂利斯（Tom Tillis）。

sentences.en: I mean, the president said he wasn't in the mix.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，总统说他没有参与其中。

sentences.en: Another example of amateur hours, as far as I'm concerned.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是业余表现的又一个例子。

sentences.en: He's a kind of a moderate Republican from North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 他是一位来自北卡罗来纳州的温和派共和党人。

sentences.en: He's not running for reelection.
sentences.zh: 他没有竞选连任。

sentences.en: Those are always the people who speak loudest in Washington.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，这些人往往说话声音最大。

sentences.en: And he comes out and he says, President Trump, whoever you send up to the Hill to replace Powell, I'm not even going to vote on if you continue down this road on this prosecution.
sentences.zh: 他站出来说，特朗普总统，无论你派谁到国会山来接替鲍威尔，如果你继续在这起起诉案上走下去，我甚至都不会进行投票。

sentences.en: Should they drop the investigation?
sentences.zh: 他们应该放弃调查吗？

sentences.en: I'm not going to get into that.
sentences.zh: 我不会讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: What I'm going to do is drop any consideration for any board confirmation until it's done.
sentences.zh: 我要做的是，在调查结束前，拒绝考虑任何董事会提名确认。

sentences.en: That just hasn't happened before.
sentences.zh: 这在以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: And then in the succeeding hours and really over the next 36 hours, we just saw this cascade of criticism.
sentences.zh: 随后在接下来的几个小时，实际上是在接下来的36小时里，我们看到了批评声如潮水般涌来。

sentences.en: I will be shocked if he has done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果他做了什么错事，我会感到震惊。

sentences.en: From places Trump isn't used to seeing criticism from.
sentences.zh: 来自特朗普不习惯受到批评的地方。

sentences.en: Fox News.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not sure this investigation will ever go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不确定这项调查会有什么结果。

sentences.en: I doubt very seriously that Jerome Powell lied to Congress in any intentional way.
sentences.zh: 我非常怀疑杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jerome Powell）会以任何蓄意的方式对国会撒谎。

sentences.en: He may have been mistaken in something he said, but I think he's an honorable man.
sentences.zh: 他可能在某些言论上犯了错，但我认为他是个正派的人。

sentences.en: Larry Kudlow.
sentences.zh: 拉里·库德洛（Larry Kudlow）。

sentences.en: He was a terrible Fed chair, but he's not a criminal.
sentences.zh: 他是个糟糕的美联储主席，但他不是罪犯。

sentences.en: One of his top economic advisors during the first term and somebody Trump watches on TV all the time said this was a stupid idea.
sentences.zh: 他第一任期内的高级经济顾问之一，也是特朗普经常在电视上关注的人，称这是一个愚蠢的主意。

sentences.en: And other members of the Senate, including John Thune, the majority leader.
sentences.zh: 还有其他参议院成员，包括多数党领袖约翰·图恩（John Thune）。

sentences.en: If the Justice Department is pursuing something, I hope they have a smoking gun.
sentences.zh: 如果司法部正在进行调查，我希望他们有确凿的证据。

sentences.en: Expressed extreme skepticism about this and said that they needed to see real evidence that Powell had committed criminality for this thing to go forward with their approval.
sentences.zh: 他们对此表示极度怀疑，并称如果这件事要继续推进并获得他们的批准，就需要看到鲍威尔确实犯罪的真实证据。

sentences.en: OK, so I understand that Powell is, you're saying, very trusted among many people on the Hill.
sentences.zh: 好的，我明白你的意思是，鲍威尔在国会山许多人中非常受信任。

sentences.en: But Glenn, we know that Republicans have been very willing to go along with a lot from Trump.
sentences.zh: 但是格伦（Glenn），我们知道共和党人一直非常愿意顺从特朗普的很多做法。

sentences.en: A lot of retribution efforts, even a lot of attacks on the Fed before this.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，有很多报复行动，甚至有很多对美联储的攻击。

sentences.en: So why do they break with him on this so forcefully?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么他们这次如此强烈地与他决裂呢？

sentences.en: In less than six months, the midterm elections are going to hit full swing.
sentences.zh: 不到六个月，中期选举就要全面展开了。

sentences.en: And there is nothing that makes Republicans speak up louder and challenge their own president than the potential prospect of losing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比失去工作的潜在前景更能让共和党人更大声地发言并挑战他们自己的总统了。

sentences.en: And anything that threatens the potential stability or the economy, they are going to fight back.
sentences.zh: 任何威胁到潜在稳定或经济的事情，他们都会反击。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what we're seeing.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们所看到的。

sentences.en: And I also think it's important to note that nothing's going to rattle financial markets more than thinking that the central bank is an independent.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为重要的一点是，没有什么比认为央行不再独立更能撼动金融市场的了。

sentences.en: And it's been notable that we haven't seen more of a market reaction.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们并没有看到市场有更大的反应。

sentences.en: I think some people were expecting in the aftermath of this that this would be a seismic moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些人曾预期这件事之后会是一个震荡时刻。

sentences.en: But a lot of what I hear is that having so many Republican lawmakers come out and say that they don't stand by attacks of this nature has has really helped to alleviate fears that the Fed isn't suddenly going to fold here and no longer act independently.
sentences.zh: 但我听到很多说法是，有这么多共和党议员站出来表示他们不支持这种性质的攻击，这确实有助于缓解人们对美联储不会突然妥协、不再独立行事的担忧。

sentences.en: But again, I mean, it's not just the economy that I think these lawmakers are focused on.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，我认为这些议员关注的不仅仅是经济。

sentences.en: It's really Wall Street, which we know is a barometer of success for the president.
sentences.zh: 实际上是华尔街，我们知道那是总统政绩的晴雨表。

sentences.en: And just say quickly why it is that Wall Street will react so strongly to the appearance that the Fed's independence is really being threatened.
sentences.zh: 请简要说明为什么华尔街会对美联储独立性受到威胁的表象反应如此强烈。

sentences.en: Well, so much of the stability of the financial system rests on the fact that we have a central bank that wants to pursue low, stable inflation and a healthy labor market.
sentences.zh: 嗯，金融体系的很大一部分稳定性建立在我们拥有一个追求低且稳定的通胀以及健康劳动力市场的央行这一事实之上。

sentences.en: And if that has changed, then I think people's assumptions about the financial system in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果这一点改变了，那么我认为人们对美国金融体系的假设

sentences.en: start to change.
sentences.zh: 就开始改变了。

sentences.en: That independence is what bolsters people's confidence in the dollar, in U.S.
sentences.zh: 这种独立性是增强人们对美元、美国国债信心的基石。

sentences.en: treasuries.
sentences.zh: 国债。

sentences.en: And so if you flip the script on Fed independence, then it really starts to change people's perspective of just how stable is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你颠覆了美联储独立性，那么人们对美国经济及其金融体系稳定性的看法就会真正开始改变。

sentences.en: economy and its financial system.
sentences.zh: 另一种思考方式是，这就像抽走了你绝对不能抽走的那块积木。

sentences.en: Another way to think about this is this is like pulling out the one Jenga piece you cannot afford to pull out.
sentences.zh: 这不是共和党人想要的。

sentences.en: This is not something that Republicans want.
sentences.zh: 这并不能增加稳定性。

sentences.en: It's not something that adds to stability.
sentences.zh: 听着，当司法部针对詹姆斯·科米（James Comey）或蒂什·詹姆斯（Tish James）时，这损害了法治的基本原则。

sentences.en: Look, when the Justice Department goes after James Comey or Tish James, it compromises fundamental issues of rule of law.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，它并没有危及整体经济。

sentences.en: But, you know, it doesn't imperil the overall economy.
sentences.zh: 那是国会山的共和党人无法容忍的。

sentences.en: That's something Republicans on the Hill cannot abide.
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普白宫对这种罕见的异议表现有何回应？

sentences.en: And what has the Trump White House response to this rare showing of dissent been?
sentences.zh: 比如，皮罗（Pirro）现在是否认为她的行为是一个错误？

sentences.en: Like, does Pirro, for example, see her actions as a mistake now?
sentences.zh: 嗯，珍妮·皮罗（Janine Pirro）对此的反应非常有趣。

sentences.en: Well, Janine Pirro's reaction to this has been really interesting.
sentences.zh: 当反弹发生时，而且几乎是瞬间发生的，皮罗通过淡化这项调查的严重性来回应。

sentences.en: When the blowback happened, and it was pretty much instantaneous, Pirro responded by downplaying the seriousness of this investigation.
sentences.zh: 她基本上说，缺乏回应才是导致这一结果的原因，调查远非起诉。

sentences.en: She essentially said that the lack of response is what precipitated this, that an investigation is far from being a prosecution.
sentences.zh: 皮罗淡化了这会导致起诉的可能性。

sentences.en: Pirro has downplayed the likelihood that this will result in prosecutions.
sentences.zh: 所以她做了一件你在特朗普时代几乎从未见过司法部人员做的事情。

sentences.en: So she did something that you almost never see Justice Department people do in the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 那就是稍微退缩了一点。

sentences.en: And that is walk it back ever so slightly.
sentences.zh: 但她是一个试图在取悦老板的愿望与保持自己作为一名受事实而非政治驱动的公正检察官形象之间寻求平衡的人。

sentences.en: But she's somebody who is attempting to balance her desire to please the boss with maintaining some semblance of her own image as an impartial prosecutor motivated by facts rather than politics.
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢，虽然国会山的共和党人和国际货币界可能认为皮罗做得太过火了，但在某种程度上，特朗普

sentences.en: And who knows, while the Republicans on the Hill and the international monetary community might think Pirro has gone way overboard, Trump, to some extent,
sentences.zh: 很可能会认为这是她在执行他想要完成的事情。

sentences.en: is quite likely to see this as her executing something that he wanted accomplished.
sentences.zh: 我们是否了解特朗普是如何看待这件事的？

sentences.en: And do we have an understanding of how Trump is perceiving this?
sentences.zh: 他的反应是什么？

sentences.en: What's his reaction been?
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普并不一定是在从这件事中退缩。

sentences.en: So, Trump is not necessarily, like, backing away from this.
sentences.zh: 他试图在他自己和调查之间制造一些距离。

sentences.en: He tried to create some distance between himself and the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他说他对此一无所知。

sentences.en: He said he didn't know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 但他当然没有借此机会，你知道，改变他关于鲍威尔的论调。

sentences.en: But he's certainly not taking the opportunity to, you know, shift his tone as it relates to Powell.
sentences.zh: 他超支了数十亿美元。

sentences.en: He's billions of dollars over budget.
sentences.zh: 所以他要么是无能，要么是腐败。

sentences.en: So he either is incompetent or he's crooked.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是哪种，但他肯定做得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I don't know what he is, but he doesn't certainly doesn't do a very good job.
sentences.zh: 最近，他，你知道，称他为混蛋，并说这其实没什么大不了的，因为他很快就会离职。

sentences.en: Recently, he, you know, called him a jerk and said that it didn't really matter much because he'd be out soon.
sentences.zh: 上周，30年期抵押贷款平均利率多年来首次降至6%以下。

sentences.en: Last week, the average 30-year mortgage dropped below 6 percent for the first time in many years.
sentences.zh: 它正在迅速下降，而且这并不是在美联储的帮助下实现的。

sentences.en: It's coming down very rapidly, and that's not with the help of the Fed.
sentences.zh: 如果我有美联储的帮助，那会更容易。

sentences.en: If I had the help of the Fed, it would be easier.
sentences.zh: 但那个混蛋很快就会走人。

sentences.en: But that jerk will be gone soon.
sentences.zh: 指的是鲍威尔的任期在五月结束这一事实。

sentences.en: Referencing the fact that Powell's term is up in May.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，在政府内部，情况要复杂一些。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that inside the administration, it's a bit more complicated.
sentences.zh: 财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）正在领导寻找鲍威尔继任者的程序，他根本不同意这个决定。

sentences.en: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who's leading the process to find Powell's replacement as chair, was not on board with this decision at all.
sentences.zh: 当他发现调查正在推进时，他直接给总统打了电话，你知道，

sentences.en: He called the president directly when he found out the investigation was moving forward and, you know,
sentences.zh: 表达了他的沮丧，并告诉总统这可能会阻碍他们确认美联储新主席的计划。

sentences.en: expressed his frustration and told the president that this could impede their plans to confirm a new chair for the Fed.
sentences.zh: 那是真的吗，科尔比（Colby）？

sentences.en: And is that true, Colby?
sentences.zh: 这真的会影响政府提名鲍威尔继任者的能力吗？

sentences.en: Like, could this actually impact the administration's ability to nominate Powell's replacement?
sentences.zh: 是的，这可能是一个巨大的障碍。

sentences.en: Yeah, this could be a big impediment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如格伦之前提到的，是蒂利斯参议员举手表示，你知道，

sentences.en: I mean, as Glenn mentioned earlier, it was Senator Tillis who kind of raised his hand and said, you know,
sentences.zh: 我不会同意批准或推进政府为这个主席职位提出的任何提名。

sentences.en: I'm not going to be on board with approving or moving along any of the nominations that the administration is putting forward for this chair position.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题，因为他是参议院银行委员会成员，他们负责审查、质询，然后投票决定谁进入参议院全体会议进行表决。

sentences.en: And that's a big problem because he's on the Senate Banking Committee and they are responsible for vetting and questioning and then voting on who proceeds to the full Senate for a vote.
sentences.zh: 如果他们失去了蒂利斯的支持，那可能会导致投票陷入僵局。

sentences.en: And if they lose Tillis, that could result in a deadlocked vote.
sentences.zh: 所以很有可能整个美联储提名程序会彻底脱轨。

sentences.en: So it could very easily be the case that the whole Fed nomination process gets thrown off the rails.
sentences.zh: 其次，鲍威尔主席很有可能决定在此之后继续担任理事。

sentences.en: Second to that, it's very possible that Chair Powell decides to stay on as a governor after this point.
sentences.zh: 他作为主席的任期在五月结束，但他从技术上讲可以在央行留任到2028年，届时他作为理事的任期届满。

sentences.en: His term as chair is up in May, but he technically can stay on at the central bank until 2028 when his term as a governor expires.
sentences.zh: 现在，这一点很重要，因为特朗普真正想做的是尽可能多地将他的支持者安插进美联储。

sentences.en: Now, this is important because what Trump really wants to do is to put as many of his supporters at the Fed as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果鲍威尔不离开，那就堵住了特朗普本可以用来安插他想要的人选的另一个空缺。

sentences.en: And if Powell doesn't leave, that blocks another vacancy that Trump would have had to put forward someone that he wanted in that position.
sentences.zh: 我们能暂停一下，思考一下这个问题吗？

sentences.en: Can we just pause and cogitate for a second on that?
sentences.zh: 你刚才所说的本质上是，这一针对鲍威尔的戏剧性举动可能既让特朗普更难安插自己的人选担任央行首脑，

sentences.en: Like, what you just said is essentially that this dramatic move against Powell may have both made it much harder for Trump to put his own person in as the head of the central bank.
sentences.zh: 也可能促使鲍威尔以投票身份在银行留任一段时间，比特朗普可能希望的时间更长。

sentences.en: And it also may prompt Powell to stay on at the bank in a voting capacity for a while, longer than Trump probably wants.
sentences.zh: 这里的悖论在于，特朗普可能因为试图对这些机构行使主导权，而失去了他在美国经济中相当大一部分的权威。

sentences.en: The paradox here is Trump may have lost a significant amount of his authority over the American economy by trying to assert dominance over these institutions.
sentences.zh: 他的野心很可能超过了他的掌控能力。

sentences.en: His reach might very well have exceeded his grasp.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们在很多语境下经常这么说，但特朗普，你知道，距离他第二个任期也就是跛脚鸭任期的后半段已经不远了。

sentences.en: I know we say this a lot in a lot of contexts, but Trump is, you know, not too far from the second half of his second and lame duck term here.
sentences.zh: 他可能把这件事推得太过了。

sentences.en: And he may have pushed this a bit too far.
sentences.zh: 他一直能够对司法部随心所欲。

sentences.en: He's been able to have his way with the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，他一直能够对国会的共和党人随心所欲。

sentences.en: He's been able to have his way with Republicans on Congress until fairly recently.
sentences.zh: 他似乎可以毫无阻力地从委内瑞拉撤走一名独裁者。

sentences.en: He can extract a dictator from Venezuela, it seems, without much resistance.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 但这家伙的支持率只有40%，他的权威是有限度的。

sentences.en: But this is a guy who's got a 40 percent approval rating and there are limits to his authority.
sentences.zh: 他在这里触碰到的也是20世纪初在美联储建立的制度性力量，

sentences.en: And what he's also hitting here are the institutional strengths that were created,
sentences.zh: 这种堡垒旨在抵御这种行政权力的攫取。

sentences.en: this bulwark in the Federal Reserve in the early 20th century, that were intended to withstand precisely this kind of an executive power grab.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个真正的时刻，可能是特朗普对经济控制力的最高点。

sentences.en: And this might be a real moment, potentially a high watermark in terms of Trump's control over the economy.
sentences.zh: 这是总统往往会犯的那种错误。

sentences.en: This is the kind of mistake that presidents tend to make.
sentences.zh: 我们倾向于认为唐纳德·特朗普完全处于历史进程之外。

sentences.en: We tend to think of Donald Trump as being completely outside of the stream of history.
sentences.zh: 但总统们，通常在他们的第二个任期内，往往在他们认为验证了他们的选举之后，

sentences.en: But presidents, typically in their second terms, oftentimes after an election that they believe validated them,
sentences.zh: 倾向于追求他们没有政治支持来实现的目标。

sentences.en: tend to reach for goals that they do not have the political support to achieve.
sentences.zh: 时间会证明这是否是其中一个例子，但早期迹象表明唐纳德·特朗普可能在这里给自己惹上了一些麻烦。

sentences.en: Time will tell if this is one of those instances, but the early indications are Donald Trump may have gotten himself into some trouble here.
sentences.zh: 那么对于鲍威尔、科尔比和美联储来说，这一切的教训是什么？

sentences.en: And for Powell, Colby, and the Fed, what is the lesson in all of this?
sentences.zh: 这个以言辞谨慎、小心翼翼不参与任何党派行为而自豪的机构，

sentences.en: This institution that prides itself on being so careful with its words and so cautious to not engage in any partisan behavior
sentences.zh: 现在已经站出来有力地捍卫了自己，而且似乎奏效了。

sentences.en: has now come out and defended itself forcefully, and it seems to be working.
sentences.zh: 那么结论是什么？

sentences.en: So what's the upshot?
sentences.zh: 我认为结论是，美联储在过去一年里表现得如此安静和非对抗性，我认为他们建立了很多尊重和善意。

sentences.en: I think the upshot here is that the Fed, in being so quiet and so non-confrontational in the past year, I think they built up a lot of respect and goodwill.
sentences.zh: 所以当总统采取了过于激进的步骤，以一种许多人认为太过分的方式攻击该机构时，

sentences.en: And so when the time came when the president took too aggressive of a step and attacked the institution in a way that so many people thought was a step too far,
sentences.zh: 当他们最终做出回应时，每个人都坐直了身子倾听。

sentences.en: when they finally did respond, everyone sat up and listened.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在我们正在进入一个新时代，官员们在指出总统所作所为时感到更加直率。

sentences.en: And I think that now we are entering a new era where officials feel a little bit more forthright in calling out the president for what he is doing.
sentences.zh: 而这反过来，我认为，将有助于加强美联储的独立性，它在过去一年左右一直受到无情的攻击。

sentences.en: And that, in turn, I think, is going to help to bolster the independence of the Fed, which had been under, you know, relentless attack in the past year or so.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，总统和政府在试图削弱美联储时，反而使它变得更强大了。

sentences.en: And in some ways, in trying to weaken the Fed, the president and the administration only made it stronger.
sentences.zh: 好吧，科尔比，格伦，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Well, Colby, Glenn, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.zh: 我们已经收到了来自对方非常重要来源的消息。

sentences.en: We have been informed by very important sources on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们已经收到了来自对方非常重要来源的消息。

sentences.en: They've said the killing is stopped and the executions won't take place.
sentences.zh: 他们表示杀戮已经停止，处决也不会再进行。

sentences.en: There was supposed to be a lot of executions today and that the executions won't take place.
sentences.zh: 原本今天会有很多处决，但现在这些处决不会发生了。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump said that the Iranian government appeared to have stopped killing protesters.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统表示，伊朗政府似乎已经停止了对示威者的杀戮。

sentences.en: Trump had been threatening to attack Iran if the government harmed demonstrators.
sentences.zh: 特朗普此前曾威胁称，如果伊朗政府伤害示威者，他将对伊朗发动攻击。

sentences.en: And he didn't say Wednesday whether he was still considering military action.
sentences.zh: 但他周三并未说明是否仍在考虑采取军事行动。

sentences.en: Does this mean military action is now off the table against Iran?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着针对伊朗的军事行动现在已经排除在外了？

sentences.en: We're going to watch it and see what the process is.
sentences.zh: 我们将持续观察，看看事态如何发展。

sentences.en: But we were given a very good statement by people that are aware of what's going on.
sentences.zh: 但我们从了解情况的人那里得到了非常好的声明。

sentences.en: Iran had announced on Wednesday that it was closing airspace across the country to commercial flights.
sentences.zh: 伊朗周三宣布，将关闭全国领空，禁止商业航班飞行。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国

sentences.en: military had evacuated personnel from Qatar amid the tensions.
sentences.zh: 军方在紧张局势下已将人员从卡塔尔撤离。

sentences.en: But after Trump's comments, a U.S.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普发表评论后，一位美国

sentences.en: military official told The Times that the Pentagon was ready to bring troops back to the base in Qatar, saying the president had given a, quote, off-ramp.
sentences.zh: 军方官员告诉《泰晤士报》，五角大楼已准备好将部队带回卡塔尔的基地，称总统提供了一个所谓的“下坡路”。

sentences.en: And Senate Republicans successfully blocked an effort to force President Trump to seek congressional approval for any military action in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 参议院共和党人成功阻止了一项旨在迫使特朗普总统在对委内瑞拉采取任何军事行动前寻求国会批准的努力。

sentences.en: Last week, it seemed that the measure to curb the president's war powers would come up for a vote after five Republican senators said they would support it.
sentences.zh: 上周，在五名共和党参议员表示支持后，这项旨在限制总统战争权力的措施似乎即将付诸表决。

sentences.en: But on Wednesday, after speaking with officials from the Trump administration, two of those senators, Josh Hawley of Missouri and Todd Young of Indiana,
sentences.zh: 但周三，在与特朗普政府官员交谈后，其中两位参议员，密苏里州的乔什·霍利和印第安纳州的托德·扬，

sentences.en: flipped their positions and joined the push to kill the measure.
sentences.zh: 改变了立场，加入了否决该措施的行列。

sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？
